property_summary: After any successful fallback call at timestamp t (10 ether, t > pastBlockTime), C stores pastBlockTime = t + 1, which is strictly greater than the current block.timestamp; the mutant stores t, which never exceeds block.timestamp, so the rule fails for any successful call.
change_summary: Set pastBlockTime to block.timestamp instead of block.timestamp + 1, changing the stored timestamp value and the timing window.
